page.content:
Aang, the Gaang, and a hundred-year war among four bending nations.

How Avatar: The Last Airbender connects

  • Creator: Michael Dante DiMartino — Michael Dante DiMartino co-created Avatar: The Last Airbender.
  • Creator: Bryan Konietzko — Bryan Konietzko co-created Avatar: The Last Airbender.
  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The 2005 series is the core Avatar: The Last Airbender work.
  • Series: The Legend of Korra — Korra is a sibling series in the same Avatar world.

What is Avatar: The Last Airbender?

Avatar: The Last Airbender is the Nickelodeon saga of Aang, the last Air Nomad and current Avatar, traveling with Katara, Sokka, Toph, and later Zuko to end the Fire Nation's war before Sozin's Comet. The Legend of Korra is a later sibling series in the same world.

Key threads lead to Michael Dante DiMartino, Bryan Konietzko, Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) and The Legend of Korra.
